question: Take the interaction partners of TP53 in the Human Protein Atlas. How many are there? Give the distribution of their main subcellular location as a bar chart and the fraction whose main location includes the nucleus. Which of the partners have a validated prognostic association (favourable or unfavourable) in any TCGA cancer cohort? Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene, Ensembl, Interactions, \"Subcellular main location\", \"Subcellular additional location\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE Gene='TP53'"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' THEN ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' OR ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510') SELECT COUNT(*) AS partners, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(pa.\"Subcellular main location\",'')) LIKE '%nucleus%') AS nucleus_main, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pa.Ensembl IS NULL) AS missing_hpa FROM p LEFT JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl=p.ensembl"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' THEN ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' OR ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510') SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(pa.\"Subcellular main location\",''),'Not available') AS main_location, COUNT(*) AS partners FROM p LEFT JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl=p.ensembl GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY partners DESC, main_location"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' THEN ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' OR ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510') SELECT pa.Gene, pa.Ensembl, cp.Cancer, cp.\"validated prognostic - favorable\" AS favorable, cp.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS unfavorable FROM p JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl=p.ensembl JOIN cancer_prognostic_data cp ON cp.Gene=pa.Gene WHERE COALESCE(cp.\"validated prognostic - favorable\",'')<>'' OR COALESCE(cp.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\",'')<>'' ORDER BY pa.Gene, cp.Cancer"}

tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' THEN ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' OR ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510') SELECT pa.Gene, pa.Ensembl, cp.Cancer, cp.\"validated prognostic - favorable\" AS favorable, cp.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS unfavorable FROM p JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl=p.ensembl JOIN cancer_prognostic_data cp ON cp.Gene=pa.Ensembl WHERE COALESCE(cp.\"validated prognostic - favorable\",'')<>'' OR COALESCE(cp.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\",'')<>'' ORDER BY pa.Gene, cp.Cancer"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' THEN ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE ensembl_gene_id_1 END ensembl FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510' OR ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510'), x AS (SELECT pa.Gene, cp.Cancer, CASE WHEN cp.\"validated prognostic - favorable\"<>'' THEN 'favourable' WHEN cp.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\"<>'' THEN 'unfavourable' END direction FROM p JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl=p.ensembl JOIN cancer_prognostic_data cp ON cp.Gene=p.ensembl WHERE cp.Cancer LIKE '%(TCGA)' AND (cp.\"validated prognostic - favorable\"<>'' OR cp.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\"<>'')) SELECT Gene, string_agg(Cancer||' ('||direction||')', '; ' ORDER BY Cancer) AS associations FROM x GROUP BY Gene ORDER BY Gene"}
